bugs.description: ApplyBatchImpl._setup_referent reads the referent from constraint.elements[1] instead of the first element, so a single-column foreign key raises IndexError and a composite one takes its table and schema from the second column.

_fk_target_is_named returns True when the foreign key already has a target Column object instead of when it identifies the target by name, so SchemaObjects._ensure_table_for_fk in schemaobj.py skips name-based foreign keys and builds placeholder tables for the wrong ones.
